One market. Every angle.

Built around the PONS move.

A leaner spin on the original idea: a PONS-first venue with clear exposure, a visible liquidation line, and no hidden path between intent and execution.

Read the mark.

One reference price powers entry, PnL, closing and liquidation. The important number never moves out of view.

Shape the risk.

Switch direction, size margin and move from 1× to 5× while the liquidation estimate updates instantly.

Settle clean.

Review the position, track it live and close into a SOL-denominated result from one trading surface.

The flow

Four beats. One position.

Lev Pad keeps the path compact enough for speed, but explicit enough to understand what the trade can cost before anything happens.

01

Connect

Bring a compatible Solana wallet and choose the account you want to use at the desk.

02

Take a side

Choose long or short on PONS, then set leverage from 1× through 5×.

03

Preview the line

Position size, entry mark, maximum loss and estimated liquidation appear before submission.

04

Manage the move

Follow open exposure and close when the thesis changes. The same market mark handles the result.

The terminal

Data dense. Decision light.

A focused market rail, full-height PONS chart, position table and order panel give the desk a professional feel without turning it into a cockpit.
